data.message: I commit to 18 tons this month and invite each of the other 24 to opt in individually—not an all-or-nothing deal. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose18 and others10, catch=250+8k; stock left=250−8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500−16k (25%). Even at k=25, 50 remain, but recovery to500 isn't guaranteed. Long-run gains aren't assured; intentions aren't enforceable; other catches need recalculation. Each: what exact catch do you intend, and does it depend on others?
